verdict.rationale: Docs claim ADK ships 'AI-aware developer resources' and 'Skills' meant to be consumed by coding assistants/agents (google-adk-docs-9, google-adk-docs-10, google-adk-docs-27), suggesting agent-oriented documentation exists, but direct probes for a standard llms.txt file and markdown-doc variants both returned 404, and no concrete URL or format for these 'AI-aware resources' is evidenced. Missing for 10: a verifiable llms.txt or documented agent-readable docs endpoint, independent confirmation that an agent can actually consume these resources.
